DISCOVERY 612, APPEARANCES: MARCUS DANIEL MERCHASIN, ESQ. FOR PLAINTIFF/MOVING PARTY, MOE LWIN. GRANT A. NIGOLIAN, ESQ. FOR DEFENDANT/OPPOSING PARTY WHO APPEARED TELEPHONICALLY. HEARING HELD. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO DEEM ADMISSION REQUESTS AS ADMITTED OR, IN THE ALTERNATIVE, TO COMPEL ACTUAL RESPONSE TO ADMISSION REQUESTS AS WELL AS COMPEL RESPONSES TO JUDICIAL COUNCIL FORM INTERROGATORIES, SPECIAL INTERROGATORIES, AND PRODUCTION REQUESTS IS GRANTED AS IT SEEKS AN ORDER COMPELLING RESPONSES. DEFENDANT IS ORDERED TO RESPOND ON OR BEFORE FEBRUARY 23, 2005. THE COURT FINDS THE FAILURE TO RESPOND AND TO MEET AND CONFER IN A REASONABLE ATTEMPT TO RESOLVE THE DISPUTE WITHOUT COURT INTERVENTION WAS A MISUSE OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS. SANCTIONS ARE IMPOSED AGAINST DEFENDANT IN THE AMOUNT OF $750, TO BE PAID WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
